title: Mistral Small joins the OpenAI-compatible text endpoint
summary:
A compact tuning pass: Mistral Small became available through the familiar OpenAI-compatible text API, with project and server housekeeping alongside it.

Mistral Small support was added to text.pollinations.ai through the OpenAI-compatible interface, giving existing API clients another model option without teaching them a new dialect.

The project directory now points PrivatePollenAI visitors to the right social link, while a server update keeps the service plumbing moving along quietly, as servers prefer.
